title: The ship and the command screen disagree about what a free pane is
notes: Three things answer 'is this pane busy' and they answer differently. paneIsBusy in ship.ts reads the pty's real foreground process, so the ship refuses a pane running 'npm run dev'. looksBusy in waiting.ts scrapes the screen for an agent's spinner or its 'esc to interrupt' line, so the same pane reads free to the command screen's Cmd+Enter and to the close-project refusal — a command gets typed on top of your dev server. workingPanes in working-panes.ts is the third, and that one is not redundant: only the screen can tell an agent still working from an agent waiting on you, which the process table cannot see. So the fix is not one predicate replacing the other two — it is main sending each pane's foreground process to the renderer over the channel that already carries reports the other way, and paneIsFree in free-pane.ts reading both. The divergence predates the typedPanes change; that change made the ship's half accurate and left the other half alone.

comments.body: Stopped: already fixed on main by 625225c (19 Sep, "command screen and close: pick a pane by what is running in it"). The command screen's Cmd+Enter and the close now ask main over panes:read and use the ship's own paneIsBusy, which reads the pane's foreground process. Run npm run dev in terminal 1, send a line to every project: terminal 1 is skipped. Close the project: refused with "terminal 1 npm". looksBusy is now only used for the bell and the working report the review sweep reads. The card's plan of reading the screen too would add nothing: an agent pane already counts as busy, either from its recorded command or from its foreground process. Nothing left to build. Suggest moving the card to Done or deleting it.
